newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 14-day securities repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 14-day securities repo tender.

text.p: The Bundesbank said it was setting a tender for 14-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed three percent rate.
Funds will be credited to accounts on Wednesday and the securities have to be repurchased on December 11, 1996.
A 66.9 billion mark facility set at a fixed interest rate of 3.00 percent expires on Wednesday. The repo rate has been set at 3.00 percent since late August.
